scope.summary: Repository-wide static security audit with independent baseline, architecture review, focused authorization/business-logic review, focused privacy/AI/infrastructure review, and parent revalidation.
limitations: Managed Deep Scan workers were unavailable.
Bundled development skills, generated/binary artifacts, live infrastructure, runtime secrets and online dependency advisories remain partial.

threatModel.summary: Multi-store Spring Boot/PostgreSQL and Next.js service behind Nginx; public QR flows issue persisted games/coupons, admins use Bearer JWT plus DB membership, field tests may use cloudflared, and optional AI sends aggregates/public labels plus admin text.
trustBoundaries: authorized store context/text to LLM provider
attackerCapabilities: targeted caller knowing a phone number
claimant of an unregistered business identifier
assumptions: Static offline review; runtime secrets, TLS terminator, database ACLs, Cloudflare behavior and current advisory feeds were not verified.

findings.title: Unauthenticated game creation can exhaust storage and serialize a store
findings.summary: A caller with a public QR token can rotate phones and idempotency keys to create unlimited games/coupons while each request holds a store-row write lock.

confidence.rationale: Validated against current source with counterevidence considered.

rootCause.summary: A caller with a public QR token can rotate phones and idempotency keys to create unlimited games/coupons while each request holds a store-row write lock.

findings.remediation: Add durable per-store/client limits and volume ceilings, and replace the store-wide lock with a customer-key concurrency strategy.

validation.summary: Source-to-sink path independently rechecked in current revision.

dataflow.summary: A caller with a public QR token can rotate phones and idempotency keys to create unlimited games/coupons while each request holds a store-row write lock.

reachability.summary: Reachability and prerequisites are stated in the finding summary and locations.

remediationTests: Add a regression test that exercises the stated attacker path and verifies the control fails closed.
